intro.title: AN INTEGRATED LUBRICANT MANUFACTURER
intro.p1: Cerotd (Shandong) Lubrication Technology Co., Ltd. integrates R&D, production, sales, technical training and logistics. Based in the New Material Industrial Park, Rencheng District, Jining, Shandong, we serve automotive, industrial and construction-machinery customers with practical lubrication solutions.
intro.p2: With 20 years in the industry, we offer 100+ products and a distributor network across 20+ provinces, serving 1,000+ dealers. Our plant supports scaled manufacturing and reliable delivery, with annual production and sales up to 150,000 tons.
intro.p3: We stay focused on professionalism and partnership, aiming for more efficient, environmentally responsible and energy-saving lubrication solutions that help customers grow with us.
